abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.description: Prevents Caterpie from being hit by additional effects of moves.

flavorText.ruby: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this POKéMON releases a terrifically strong odor.
flavorText.sapphire: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this POKéMON releases a terrifically strong odor.
flavorText.emerald: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.
flavorText.firered: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.
flavorText.leafgreen: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
